title: SkVM authorization authoring v2 (editor structure)
description: Author-authored task input. Structure validation does not establish source semantics or policy correctness.
$comment: Runtime-only checks are enumerated and exercised in src/benchmarks/authorization-dsl/editor-support/verify.ts: line order, references, repeated references, policy readiness, Unicode well-formedness, source paths/files and source locations. This schema does not prove authorization correctness.

schemaVersion.description: Exact authoring language version; no editor-specific fields are allowed in the declaration.

taskId.description: Author-chosen identifier for this bounded assessment.

request.description: Natural-language question and scenario facts supplied by the task author.

repository.description: Identity of the single repository being assessed; author-declared, not fetched or verified by this schema.

sourceRef.description: Author-declared revision of the supplied source; this field does not verify a checkout.

sourceRoot.description: Directory relative to this input JSON file. Runtime requires it to remain beneath that directory and checks real paths.

items.description: Explicit source path relative to sourceRoot; use supplied-file line numbers in entry locations.

sources.description: Non-empty list of the source files available for this assessment.

policies.description: Named author-provided policies. Policy acceptance and expectations must not be guessed from implementation.

entries.description: Named source entry points; locations refer to the supplied local files.

scenarios.description: Named authorization obligations linking declared actors, resources, policies and entries.

additionalQuestions.description: Optional questions appended to the common analysis requirements.

additionalConstraints.description: Optional constraints appended to the bounded source-visible assessment constraints.

text.description: Text must contain a non-whitespace character. Runtime trims surrounding whitespace; editor checks do not rewrite the input.

key.description: A named declaration or reference. No surrounding whitespace, ASCII control characters or reserved prototype names. Well-formed Unicode is checked by runtime.

policy.description: A policy and its author-controlled provenance.

text.description: Explicit policy text authored independently of the implementation.

location.description: Author-provided policy provenance, such as a document path, URL or JSON pointer.

revision.description: Version of the policy source supplied by the author.

acceptance.description: Author's acceptance state. Runtime blocks scenarios that reference a policy which is not accepted.

reason.description: Author's explanation of policy acceptance or unresolved disagreement.

principal.description: A named principal; runtime does not infer omitted facts.

role.description: Declared principal role, such as member or supervisor.

facts.description: Optional known facts; omission means not declared.

capabilities.description: Optional starting capabilities; omission means not declared.

resource.description: A resource referenced by one or more scenarios.

facts.description: Optional known facts; omission means not declared.

location.description: Location in the exact supplied file, not an upstream excerpt's original line numbers.

path.description: Source path relative to sourceRoot and present in sources.

startLine.description: First included line in the supplied file, one-based.

endLine.description: Last included line, inclusive. Runtime checks endLine >= startLine and the actual file length.

entry.description: A named entry point and its source ranges.

name.description: Human-readable entry or function name; not a symbol resolver.

locations.description: One or more explicit supplied-source ranges.

condition.description: Named scenario condition; omitted conditions are not inferred.

basis.description: Author-provided reason or evidence for considering this condition.

names.description: Declared condition names to analyze. Runtime checks existence and repeated names.

maxBranches.description: Optional branch bound (1 through 12); runtime lowering uses 8 when omitted.

scenario.description: An authored authorization obligation; JSON validity alone does not show that it is runnable.

principal.description: Name in principals; reference existence is checked by runtime.

resource.description: Name in resources; reference existence is checked by runtime.

policy.description: Name in policies. The referenced policy must be accepted to run.

entries.description: Names in entries. Runtime rejects unknown or repeated names.

relation.description: Explicit principal/resource relationship, such as same-owner or different-owner.

expectation.description: Author-provided policy expectation; never infer this from the implementation's behavior.

conditions.description: Optional named conditions with author-provided bases; an empty dictionary is permitted.

analyzeConditions.description: Optional request to enumerate bounded outcomes for the named conditions.
